typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as string,
		{PDU NO } as string,
		{CIRCUIT NO } as string,
		{POWER SOURCE A B} as string,
		{PREVIOUS READINGS (KWH)} as string,
		{CURRENT READING (KWH)} as string,
		{UNIT CONSUMED PER SOURCE} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CIRCUIT_NO as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		POWER_SOURCE_A_B as string,
		PDU_NO as string,
		UNIT_CONSUMED_PER_SOURCE as double,
		PREVIOUS_READINGS_Kwh as string,
		Date as string,
		FName as string,
		CURRENT_READING as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CIRCUIT_NO = {CIRCUIT NO },
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		POWER_SOURCE_A_B = {POWER SOURCE A B},
		PDU_NO = {PDU NO },
		UNIT_CONSUMED_PER_SOURCE = {UNIT CONSUMED PER SOURCE},
		PREVIOUS_READINGS_Kwh = {PREVIOUS READINGS (KWH)},
		Date,
		FName,
		CURRENT_READING = {CURRENT READING (KWH)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
